FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Favor
FAQ.a1: Favor is a decentralized service marketplace in Telegram where you can make secure deals, create smart contracts, and find contractors. We offer secure Escrow deals with a 5% fee, as well as the option to conduct free deals with zero commission.
FAQ.a2: With a Favor Plus subscription, you can keep up to 5 active contracts, view contacts without restrictions, and get priority in search.
FAQ.a3: Favor Plus can be paid with Telegram Stars or GRAM. Secure Escrow deals support GRAM and USDT.
FAQ.a4: All subscription payments in FAVOR tokens are burned directly on the TON blockchain, which reduces the total token supply and creates a sustainable deflationary effect.

intro.title: What is Favor?
intro.description: Favor turns any work agreement from Telegram into a clear contract: what needs to be done, what it costs, when it is due, and what result is expected.
intro.instruction: It is a place for real work between people — from the first agreement to the final review.
intro.imageAlt: A family photo session chat becomes a Favor contract

roles.title: Favor is for everyone
roles.description: You do not have to be a developer. Photographers, tutors, designers, makers, organizers, translators, lawyers, and many other professionals can find clients and collaborators here.
roles.instruction: Choose your role in every contract: offer a service or find someone who can help.
roles.imageAlt: Role selection with a range of service categories

feed.title: Find what you need
feed.description: The feed brings services and tasks together. Search and filter them by category, price, deadline, and payment format.
feed.instruction: Open a relevant card and check its description, terms, questions, rating, and reviews.
feed.imageAlt: Family photo session card in the Favor feed

create.title: Describe a service or task
create.description: Create a service or task card with materials, a clear description, price, deadline, and terms.
create.instruction: Fill it in manually or import text and images from a public Telegram post. A channel is optional.

proposal.title: Agree on the work
proposal.description: Before work starts, confirm the result, exact price, deadline, and important details. Ask the author if any terms are unclear.
proposal.instruction: Once everything is clear, send your proposal and wait for the other party to confirm it.
proposal.imageAlt: Contract card with questions and the proposal form

deal.title: Track the deal
deal.description: Favor shows the current stage, deadline, materials, and result. You can keep talking directly in Telegram.
deal.instruction: Choose direct payment or a protected Escrow deal, then update each stage as the work progresses.
deal.imageAlt: Deal screen with status, deadline, and result

profile.title: Build your reputation
profile.description: Completed contracts, your portfolio, rating, and reviews help future clients trust you sooner.
profile.instruction: After the work is done, confirm the result, exchange reviews, and add your best case to the portfolio.
profile.imageAlt: Favor profile with portfolio, rating, and reviews

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.intro: Welcome to Favor. By accessing or using our platform via Telegram or our web interface, you agree to these Terms of Service.
Terms.s1_content: Favor is a decentralized marketplace for freelancers and customers operating primarily through Telegram. We provide a platform for users to create contracts, offer services, and conduct deals.
Terms.s2_content: Your account is linked to your Telegram profile. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your Telegram account and TON wallet (if connected).
Terms.s3_content: Deals can be conducted via direct settlement or through our secure TON Escrow smart contract. Escrow deals are subject to a 5% platform fee. Direct deals have zero commission.
Terms.s4_content: In the event of a dispute in an Escrow deal, either party can request arbitration. The decisions made by an arbitrator are final and not subject to review. However, all arbitrators have a public channel for explaining their choices or for public criticism of their actions.
Terms.s5_content: Users must not engage in fraudulent, illegal, or abusive activities. Favor reserves the right to suspend or ban users who violate these rules.
Terms.s6_content: Favor is provided 'as is'. We are not responsible for any disputes, losses, or damages arising from direct deals. For Escrow deals, our liability is limited to the proper execution of the smart contract logic.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Favor collects, uses, and protects your information.
Privacy.s1_content: We collect information provided by Telegram (such as your user ID, username, and profile photo) when you log in. We also collect your TON wallet address if you connect it. For signed-in users, we store search queries, every applied filter state (including filter-only searches and resets), the search area, and client and server timestamps, and link each event to the account. Guest search history remains on the device.
Privacy.s2_content: Your information is used to create your profile, facilitate deals, display contracts, synchronize search history for signed-in users, improve search, and send notifications via our Telegram bot.
Privacy.s3_content: We do not sell your personal information. Your username and profile details are publicly visible on your contracts and deals to build trust within the marketplace.
Privacy.s4_content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
Privacy.s5_content: You have the right to request the deletion of your account and associated data. Please contact our support team to exercise these rights.
